caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a vintage mechanical bank in the shape of a frog sitting atop a round, lattice-patterned base. The frog is green with dark shading, and its body shows tones of brown and black, particularly on the head and front limbs. The frog’s right front leg is extended and its right hand is pressing down on a coiled spring-like mechanism. The base of the object is cylindrical with a metallic appearance in green and gold tones. The sides of the base have a lattice design and a small arched door is visible on the side, above which the word "BANK" is inscribed. The top surface of the base is red, contrasting with the greenish frog and the lower section. The background is plain and untextured, and the artist’s signature, "CHRYS MAKRENOS," appears in the lower right corner in gray.
title: Toy Bank: Frog
